topics.title: Stages in the formation of a company

concepts.learning_objective: Name the three stages in the formation of a company in their proper order and identify the promoters who carry them out.
Explain why a private company does not need the capital subscription stage while a public company raising public funds does.

topics.title: Promotion and the functions of a promoter

concepts.learning_objective: State who is a promoter under section 69 and distinguish promoters from professionals who merely assist them.
Distinguish between technical, financial and economic feasibility of a business opportunity.
Explain how a company's name is approved and when a proposed name is considered undesirable.

topics.title: Memorandum of Association and its clauses

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the Memorandum of Association is the most important document of a company.
Identify the contents of the name, registered office and objects clauses of the Memorandum.
Apply the liability and capital clauses to calculate a member's liability and the limit on share issues.

topics.title: Articles of Association and other documents for registration
topics.ncert_sections: 7.2.1 (Documents required to be submitted: B to F)

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the Articles of Association as rules of internal management subsidiary to the Memorandum.
Identify the consent of directors, agreement, statutory declaration and fee receipt filed for registration.
Distinguish between the Memorandum and the Articles of Association on objectives, position and validity of acts.

topics.title: Legal position of promoters and preliminary contracts

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the fiduciary position of promoters, their liability and their right to expenses and remuneration.
Explain what preliminary contracts are and who is bound by them.

topics.title: Incorporation and the Certificate of Incorporation

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the application for incorporation, the documents filed with it and the role of the Registrar.
Explain the effect of the Certificate of Incorporation as conclusive evidence of a company's legal existence.
Explain the meaning of a prospectus and the need for SEBI approval before raising funds from the public.
Apply the 90 per cent minimum subscription rule to decide whether shares can be allotted.
Describe the stock exchange application, allotment of shares and filing of the return of allotment.
